page.overview:
Who is Akami Rowe?

is the Guildmaster of the Navigator's Guild and the Helmswoman in the flying city of Avalir. As an NPC in Exandria Unlimited: Calamity, was played by Brennan Lee Mulligan.

The day before the Calamity and 10 minutes before sunrise, Akami connected with Laerryn Coramar-Seelie via Sending to report on the status of their flight. The city would be right above Cathmoíra and in position to start its descent sometime shortly after 1:00 in the morning and should be terrestrial about 10 minutes before sunrise.

Around 1:00 in the morning, Akami connected with Laerryn once again to report that Avalir was in position over Cathmoíra (at the intersection of all three leylines) and the automated protocol of descent had begun. She intended to stay and oversee the entire process, but began choking on her last words as she was attacked by an unknown assassin.
